aadharNumber.title: aadharNumber
aadharNumber.description: Accept the patient's 12-digit Aadhar Number as a required input. Ensure the input contains only numeric characters (no spaces or special characters). Validate that the length is exactly 12 digits before proceeding. This number is used to look up the corresponding patient record in the Flow. Prompt the user clearly if the input is missing or incorrectly formatted, and request a valid 12-digit Aadhar Number.
